name: What factors should I consider when deciding between a natural gas line and propane for my grill?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when deciding between a natural gas line and propane for my grill?

acceptedAnswer.text: When deciding between a natural gas line and propane, consider your grilling frequency, budget, and convenience preferences. Natural gas offers unlimited fuel and lower per-unit costs, but requires a professional installation and initial setup expense. Propane offers portability and lower upfront grill costs but requires tank refills and storage. Consider your long-term grilling habits and whether the convenience of a permanent natural gas connection outweighs the initial investment and the loss of grill mobility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider grilling frequency, budget, and convenience; natural gas offers unlimited fuel while propane provides portability with tank refills.
